<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Admins struggle to assign roles to new team members because permissions must be configured manually for each user, with no way to copy settings. A single missed setting locks users out, delaying work and increasing frustration. Customers describe the process as tedious, error-prone, and a bottleneck, with one admin reporting spending 45 minutes ticking boxes for one person [i:a8891ea78f4a4fd7]. The inability to copy access roles forces a manual rebuild from scratch for each new user [i:b706326e7d67e7e1].

## Who is affected
- **System Administrators and Team Leads** responsible for onboarding new claims handlers, who must manually assign dozens of permissions per user [i:a24e4282e76a71f7].
- **New Team Members** who are locked out of critical tasks like assigning new tasks or accessing the letters tab when a permission is missed during setup [i:0eb62e5b2cc98b08].
- **Onboarding and Support Teams** who field requests and spend significant time resolving these configuration errors, as evidenced by 9 mentions via the support route and 5 via onboarding [i:147161dbe208c605][i:263f3fed3c88cf7a][i:6e11883921a88c93].

## Evidence
- **Volume of Feedback:** This issue has been mentioned 16 times across 9 accounts [i:1a7f26418b6c0389][i:795e6398b711b1eb][i:f953be575a4c6d0f]. The feedback comes via 4 routes: support (9 mentions), onboarding (5 mentions), sessions (1 mention), and sales (1 mention) [i:41691bca9126d789][i:57d6d279757658fb].
- **High-Value Accounts:** Affected accounts represent significant revenue, including Wexmoor Motor (ARR £1,950,000.0) with 3 mentions, Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR £2,400,000.0) with 1 mention, and Quillon Business Insurance (ARR £860,000.0) with 2 mentions [i:932f8297bbf1ee74][i:ef8656968a228702][i:97b91e5a55057966]. The total ARR of all accounts in the fact sheet is £6,865,000.0.
- **Specific Pain Points:** Admins report that the manual process is slow, with one stating, I just spent 45 minutes ticking boxes for one person [i:a8891ea78f4a4fd7]. The risk of error is high, as a single missed box can lock a user out of their tasks [i:ea0af217a06f0a72]. The lack of a role-copying function is repeatedly cited as the core problem [i:b706326e7d67e7e1].
- **Renewal Context:** 3 accounts have renewed in the last 90 days, and several major accounts, including Ashcombe Property Mutual (ARR £250,000.0), have a renewal date of 2026-11-30 [i:a24e4282e76a71f7].

## Why now
- **Team Expansion:** Multiple accounts are actively setting up new claims teams, which triggers the painful permission setup process. Selsby Motor mentioned dreading the permissions setup for a new claims team [i:147161dbe208c605], and Quillon Business Insurance reported the duplication is slowing them down during setup [i:f953be575a4c6d0f].
- **Concentrated Feedback Timeline:** 14 of the 16 insights were recorded between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-29, indicating this is a current and ongoing pain point for customers [i:263f3fed3c88cf7a][i:a8891ea78f4a4fd7].
- **Sales Cycle Impact:** The issue is salient enough that a prospective customer, Hollinbrook Home Insurance, specifically asked about role assignment during a sales demonstration [i:57d6d279757658fb], suggesting it is a competitive consideration.",
  "citations": ["0eb62e5b2cc98b08", "a8891ea78f4a4fd7", "b706326e7d67e7e1", "147161dbe208c605", "263f3fed3c88cf7a", "6e11883921a88c93", "1a7f26418b6c0389", "795e6398b711b1eb", "f953be575a4c6d0f", "41691bca9126d789", "57d6d279757658fb", "932f8297bbf1ee74", "ef8656968a228702", "97b91e5a55057966", "ea0af217a06f0a72", "a24e4282e76a71f7"]
}
